title: Mirror Trading International Opportunity Presentation & Business
description: Mirror Trading International offers you the best and most sustainable way to increase your Bitcoin. Sign up today: ...

asr.full_text: Welcome to the Mirror Trading International opportunity Mirror Trading International is a trading and networking company founded in April 2019 Johan Steenbuyck, the CEO and Founder is from Polikwani in South Africa The trading system of Mirror Trading International utilizes advanced trading software with built-in artificial intelligence that dynamically adjusts to trading and market conditions To join the club you will need your own Bitcoin wallet and you'll need to register with Mirror Trading International and have the minimum of a hundred dollars in Bitcoin for your membership. In Mirror Trading International, there are no packages. Your membership continues as long as you keep a minimum balance of a hundred dollars in your Club account. Your membership is always in bitcoin you earn bitcoin daily and when the price of bitcoin rises so will the value of your membership the system is fully automated and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statements detailing the results of the trades for the day withdrawal requests will be sent to your bitcoin wallet within 48 hours. That summarizes the passive part of the opportunity, and as a member you will receive bonuses from the trading activities. No recruiting is necessary to receive passive bonuses. Should you wish to refer your friends you will earn a 10% referral bonus for every member who joins you, and also for any amount they add over and above the original investment the business opportunity with Meritrading international financial freedom is no longer just a dream all bonuses come from daily trading results and is therefore 100% financially sustainable the multi-level marketing system of married trading international is simple and consists of the 10% Referral bonuses and 20% binary profit sharing bonuses Daily bonuses are diverted as follows. 40% to you the member, 30% to the trading system, 10% to Mirror Trading International and to pay the referral bonuses And 20% to the binary profit sharing bonuses the 20% comes from the daily bonuses and the binary bonuses are paid weekly Meritrading International is a real company and just like any company if there are no trading profits there can be no bonuses to qualify for binary bonuses, you'll also need a minimum membership of $200 and you will need to have personally recruited one new member into your left and one into your right leg. The Binary Profit Sharing bonuses are awarded according to your level of membership. With a membership from $200 to $999, you'll receive bonuses up to 10 levels deep in the binary. A membership of a thousand dollars to four thousand nine hundred and ninety nine dollars you will receive bonuses up to twenty levels deep. Five thousand dollars to nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine dollars receive bonuses up to 30 levels deep and ten thousand dollars plus will receive bonuses on infinite levels of the binary structure in your weakest leg. The third person you personally introduce will become spillover for one of the binary structure in your weakest leg. The third person you personally introduce will become spillover for one of the people you introduced before, as you can only place on your left or right side. Spillover will also occur if your sponsor or team members above you introduce people into a leg. 20% of the bonuses from the week's trading will be shared according to the value of your smallest binary team. The binary profit-sharing bonuses are paid weekly and create a real reoccurring passive income. Miratrading International is the opportunity we have all been looking for. Join the club today, build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom. If you have questions or want more information please contact Clint

textual.observation: The description promises increasing Bitcoin, while the ASR ties membership to registration, a personal Bitcoin wallet, a minimum $100 Bitcoin balance, daily Bitcoin earnings, and withdrawals sent to the wallet within 48 hours.

evidence.quote: Mirror Trading International offers you the best and most sustainable way to increase your Bitcoin.
To join the club you will need your own Bitcoin wallet and you'll need to register with Mirror Trading International and have the minimum of a hundred dollars in Bitcoin for your membership.
withdrawal requests will be sent to your bitcoin wallet within 48 hours.

textual.context: Presented as part of an opportunity promotion; the records do not independently verify the return or withdrawal claims.
textual.potential_relevance: Promised Bitcoin growth and daily earnings are linked to registration, wallet use, maintaining a $100 Bitcoin membership balance, and a stated 48-hour withdrawal timeframe.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the returns, timing, or withdrawals occurred or were independently verified.

textual.observation: A 10% referral bonus is offered for each member who joins through the viewer's referral and for additional amounts those members add above the original investment.

evidence.quote: Should you wish to refer your friends you will earn a 10% referral bonus for every member who joins you, and also for any amount they add over and above the original investment

textual.context: Promotional referral offer; this passage frames referral as optional.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised bonus is directly linked to referring friends who join and to additional amounts those members add.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether referred members joined or whether any bonus was paid.

textual.observation: Binary profit-sharing bonuses are conditioned on a $200 minimum membership and personally recruiting one member into each of two legs, with payout depth increasing by membership tier.

evidence.quote: to qualify for binary bonuses, you'll also need a minimum membership of $200 and you will need to have personally recruited one new member into your left and one into your right leg.
With a membership from $200 to $999, you'll receive bonuses up to 10 levels deep in the binary.
A membership of a thousand dollars to four thousand nine hundred and ninety nine dollars you will receive bonuses up to twenty levels deep.

textual.context: The source describes a membership-tiered binary bonus structure within the promoted business opportunity.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised bonus is linked to a paid membership threshold and recruiting others into a left/right binary structure.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the structure operated as described or whether any bonuses were paid.

textual.observation: The promotion links joining and building the business with weekly trading-based bonuses, recurring passive income, and a journey to financial freedom.

evidence.quote: The binary profit-sharing bonuses are paid weekly and create a real reoccurring passive income.
Join the club today, build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom.
all bonuses come from daily trading results

textual.context: Promotional claims are paired with a direct invitation to join and build the business.
textual.potential_relevance: Income and financial-freedom claims are directly connected to joining the club, building the business, and trading-based bonus activity.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the amount, likelihood, or outcome of the claimed income or financial freedom.

visual.observation: A branded slide states that advanced software trades while viewers benefit and that no trading knowledge is required. Another slide states that daily trading continues if the viewer keeps a minimum balance of $100 in a club account.
visual.context: Promotional presentation for Mirror Trading International.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed trading benefit is linked to maintaining a specified $100 account balance, creating a return claim tied to a payment or balance condition.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish how the account is opened, whether funds are transferred, or whether any trading or benefit occurred.

visual.observation: A slide states that withdrawal requests are paid within 48 hours into a Bitcoin wallet.
visual.context: Promotional slide describing an advertised withdrawal process.
visual.potential_relevance: A specific payout timeframe and cryptocurrency destination are presented as an expected withdrawal outcome.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show an actual withdrawal request, transaction, wallet address, or payment outcome.

visual.observation: The presentation advertises a 10% referral bonus for introducing new members and separately displays 10% referral and 20% binary profit-sharing bonuses.
visual.potential_relevance: Promised bonuses are explicitly connected to introducing or recruiting new members and to a binary profit-sharing structure.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the full eligibility rules, whether bonuses were paid, or the outcome for participants.

visual.observation: Slides show a binary structure requiring personally introduced members on the left and right, a personal membership amount of $200, higher membership tiers with bonuses extending multiple levels, and spillover placement of introduced people.
visual.context: Promotional explanation of membership and binary-placement mechanics.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed compensation outcomes are connected to membership payments and building or placing recruits across left and right legs, with higher membership amounts linked to deeper bonus levels.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish whether every participant must pay a membership amount, the complete payout conditions, or any actual earnings.

textual_context_notes.observation: The records present the material as an opportunity and business promotion with a direct join-and-build call to action.

evidence.quote: Mirror Trading International Opportunity Presentation & Business
Join the club today, build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source distinguishes passive bonuses from binary bonuses: it says recruiting is unnecessary for passive bonuses, then separately requires personal recruitment for binary bonuses.

evidence.quote: No recruiting is necessary to receive passive bonuses.
to qualify for binary bonuses, you'll also need a minimum membership of $200 and you will need to have personally recruited one new member into your left and one into your right leg.

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled slides consistently use Mirror Trading International branding and present trading, membership, referral, and bonus claims in a promotional deck format.
One slide states that recruiting is not required to receive daily trading bonuses.
A footnote states that the binary qualification requires at least one personally introduced member on the left and one on the right.
The final sampled slide provides a WhatsApp number and email address under a 'Questions' heading.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a Bitcoin opportunity that requires a funded membership while promising automated daily earnings, withdrawals, and financial freedom. It also promotes recruitment-dependent bonuses requiring members to place recruits in left and right legs, with payouts extending across multiple levels and larger membership tiers. The presentation directly encourages viewers to join, build the business, and contact the promoter.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted income includes a binary multi-level structure in which qualification requires personally recruiting one member on each side, and bonus depth increases with membership amount. S02 is additionally supported by the claimed automated trading software being linked to daily earnings after funding membership, while S03 is supported by the promoted passive Bitcoin returns and recurring income claims.

evidence.observation: The slide states that advanced intelligent software trades and the viewer benefits, and that no trading knowledge is required.
The slide lists a Bitcoin wallet, registration with MTI, and $100 in Bitcoin as requirements to start.
The slide states that binary qualification requires one personally introduced person on the left and one personally introduced person on the right, with a personal membership of $200.
The narration explicitly ties qualification for binary bonuses to recruiting members into two legs.
evidence.quote: personally recruited one new member into your left and one into your right leg

evidence.observation: The slide presents bonuses 10 levels, 20 levels, 30 levels, and infinite levels deep as membership amounts increase from $200 to $10,000 or more.
The narrator directly encourages viewers to join and build the promoted business, framing it as a path to financial freedom.
evidence.quote: Join the club today, build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom
